answer: Each answer is shingled into five-token grams and reduced to a 128-permutation MinHash sketch kept in place of the text. When two identities land within 0.55 estimated Jaccard in one epoch, both merge into one weight unit for three epochs and forfeit that reward, so one template across a garden of aliases collects one share. The sketch travels with the funding key, so a fresh key keeps the stale sketch. Honest text drifts apart; a crystal-clear copy signal collapses the cluster into one identity that still does one identity's work.
